The Situation Before the Stack

The creator was selling digital products, such as ebooks and courses, but was unable to collect payments from international buyers due to the restrictions on Stripe in Ethiopia. This meant that the creator had to rely on manual payment methods, which were time-consuming and unreliable. The creator wanted to find a way to automate the payment process and expand their customer base to international buyers.
Why Conventional Options Had Already Failed

Conventional payment options like PayPal and Stripe were not available in Ethiopia, and even if they were, they would have imposed significant fees on the creator. The creator also wanted to avoid relying on a single payment platform, which could be shut down or restricted at any time. Additionally, the creator wanted to maintain full control over their payment infrastructure and data.
The Infrastructure That Was Deployed

The creator built a payment options for Ethiopian digital creators stack using Cloudflare infrastructure and NOWPayments. The stack included a Cloudflare Pages site for hosting, a Cloudflare Workers backend for processing payments, and a Supabase database for storing order information. NOWPayments was used to handle the payment processing and provide a seamless checkout experience for customers.
